_comment: Copy this to .idle-loop/agents-apps.json (gitignored) and fill in. One GitHub App per agent, all owned by viksuper555. client_id is the JWT issuer GitHub recommends (app_id is an accepted fallback — keep whichever you have; client_id wins if both are set). Both are on the app's settings page. installation_id is in the install URL (.../installations/<id>) or `gh api /repos/viksuper555/idle-loop/installation --jq .id`. private_key is the .pem you download when you generate the app's key. NEVER commit the filled-in file or the .pem keys.
